events.title: Rally at the Ravines
events.description:
Join us at the beautiful Ravines Gardens State Park on October 23rd for a chance to connect with your neighbors and the candidates working to represent you.
Bring your friends and family for a community-driven event with free refreshments, music, and guest speakers.
Come let candidates know what issues are important to you and hear how they plan to represent all of Putnam.
Guest Speakers Include:
- Joshua Florence, candidate for Putnam County Commissioner District 4
- Eric Yonce, candidate for U.S. Congress, Florida's 6th District
- Local Organizers and Community Leaders
